_comment: ARB source for the Assisto MY CIRCLE HUB top-level UI (.phaseB/MESSENGER_UI_FULL.md §2): hub top-bar (camera + overflow), search bar, filter chips, ⋮ menu, and the three new screens (Broadcast lists, Linked devices, Starred messages). Each entry key:[bn,en]; both always filled, never mixed. camelCase keys. ORIGINAL Assisto wording — never WhatsApp/Meta text. Dynamic names/counts injected by the Flutter layer; Bn digits rendered via codepoints in Dart so numeric placeholders stay ASCII.
